title: PO Management UI
notes: Authored by hand from SPEC_US-455386.txt only. The delivered artifacts were NOT consulted, so this states what the story asks for, not what was built.
The story writes the entity as 'Production Order'; recorded as the CMF entity type name 'ProductionOrder'. 'Material' and 'Step' are unchanged.
Grid column scalar types are not stated by the story and are therefore omitted rather than inferred. Only the two wizard form fields carry a stated type.
The Comment column is marked '(Material comments, link)'. The story does not name the entity it links to, so no entity is recorded.

AMBIGUITY: Change Priority names both a data source (CustomUpdateMaterialsPriority) and a UI page (CustomChangePriorityWizard). Whether the page-level button calls the service, or only opens the wizard which calls it, is not stated.
GAP: Hold and Release are given no data source and no UI page. What they invoke is unstated.
GAP: the story does not say how filtering is triggered - on change, on Enter, or via a search button.
GAP: no layout, geometry or widget placement is specified anywhere in the story.

GAP: the description mentions updating the 'IsHot property' for multiple materials; IsHot appears as a Materials grid column and as a wizard field, but no page-level control for setting it is described outside the wizard.

Link columns carry no target entity. The story marks Name, Product, Material, Step and Comment as links but never names what they link to; an independent extraction omitted all five and was right to. Earlier drafts inferred Product->Product and Material->Material, which is an assumption, not something the story states.
